iotsa_v4.description: iotsa's own custom PCB: ESP-12 module, FTDI programming header. The reference ESP8266 target.
iotsa_v4.constraints: No BLE. HTTPS unreliable on ESP8266 (see cwi-dis/iotsa#159).
iotsa_v4.notes: The canonical ESP8266 target; the vanilla_esp8266 alias points here.

esp32thing.description: Historic default ESP32 board: lots of I/O, onboard LiPo charger. Now overpriced and physically large.
esp32thing.notes: Canonical vanilla_esp32 target for CI. Being phased out for esp32dev / pico32 / lolin32(_lite).

esp32dev.description: Generic ESP32 devkit, usually a cheap clone. No LiPo charger.
esp32dev.notes: Known to work, not continuously CI-tested. Current pick when no charger is needed.

lolin32.description: Compact ESP32 with an onboard TP4054 LiPo charger and JST-PH battery connector.
lolin32.provenance: off-the-shelf; key name is historical (the full LOLIN32 is not used, pio_board is the Lite -- cwi-dis/iotsa#228)
lolin32.constraints: Fewer GPIOs broken out than a full devkit.
lolin32.notes: The 'lolin32' key is kept (not renamed to lolin32_lite) so downstream `extends = lolin32` keeps resolving. Current pick when a LiPo charger is wanted.

lolin32_oled.description: ESP32 with a built-in 0.96" 128x64 SSD1306 wired to GPIO5 (SDA) / GPIO4 (SCL). No LiPo charger.
lolin32_oled.provenance: no PlatformIO/Arduino profile of its own; builds as lolin32_lite
lolin32_oled.constraints: Built-in OLED occupies GPIO5/GPIO4; fewer GPIOs broken out; no charger.
lolin32_oled.notes: Added in cwi-dis/iotsa#229. lolin32_lite is used because its LED_BUILTIN=GPIO22 does not clash with the OLED's SDA on GPIO5 (the full lolin32 profile's GPIO5 would).

pico32.description: Small ESP32-PICO board: enough pins, cheap. No LiPo charger.
pico32.constraints: Minimodule JTAG debugging shares pins with the touchpads.
pico32.notes: Used by the lissabon ledstrip appliances.

esp32c3devkit.description: Reference ESP32-C3 devkit, external USB-serial chip.
esp32c3devkit.constraints: No PCNT (no rotary encoder), no touch, no analog voltage reading, no deep-sleep wakeup. Reduced WiFi TX power defaults on.

esp32c3lcd.description: ESP32-C3 with an attached LCD and only 2 MB flash.
esp32c3lcd.constraints: 2 MB flash: bare_minimum_2MB.csv partitions, extremely tight. Plus all ESP32-C3 limits.
esp32c3lcd.notes: Barely fits a full-featured app; no iotsa example or downstream user yet.

esp32c3supermini.description: Tiny cheap ESP32-C3 board, native USB-Serial/JTAG, 4 MB flash.
esp32c3supermini.constraints: All ESP32-C3 limits (no PCNT / touch / analog Vbat / deep-sleep wakeup).
esp32c3supermini.notes: The in-progress P1-port-powered iotsaSmartMeter build targets this (cwi-dis/iotsaSmartMeter#1).

crowpanel128.description: ESP32-C3 with a built-in 1.28" round IPS LCD (GC9A01).
crowpanel128.constraints: min_spiffs.csv required -- a full C3 app (LovyanGFX + HTTPS) overflows default.csv (cwi-dis/iotsa#226). Plus all ESP32-C3 limits.
crowpanel128.notes: Used by iotsaNeoClock's round-LCD clock. Partitions fixed in cwi-dis/iotsa#226.

esp32s3supermini.description: Tiny cheap ESP32-S3 board, native USB-Serial/JTAG, 4 MB flash + 2 MB PSRAM.
esp32s3supermini.constraints: Clone boards run hot; intermittent WiFi drops even with wifiPowerReduction (cwi-dis/iotsa#194). USB-OTG/TinyUSB not implemented.
esp32s3supermini.notes: BLE confirmed working, including BLE/HPS-only (no WiFi) operation.

vanilla_esp8266.description: iotsa's current default plain ESP8266 target.

vanilla_esp32.description: iotsa's current default plain ESP32 target.

vanilla_esp32c3.description: iotsa's current default plain ESP32-C3 target.

vanilla_esp32s3.description: iotsa's current default plain ESP32-S3 target.
